messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager triggered for prod-east /generate error-rate spike (alert: gen-api-5xx-rate). Paging jamal

jamal: acked. looking now. saw a sharp bump in 502/504s starting ~00:18 UTC.

jamal: immediate mitigation: scaling up gateway pool by 2 nodes (manual), enabling fallback model-v_small for non-SLA customers to reduce pressure. posting short timeline in case we need postmortem.

maya: saw a lot of repeated log lines like:
```
ERROR 2026-03-14T00:18:22Z handler.go:412 upstream-invoke failed: io-timeout after 3s, request_id=abc123
ERROR 2026-03-14T00:18:22Z handler.go:412 upstream-invoke failed: io-timeout after 3s, request_id=abc124
WARN  2026-03-14T00:18:22Z client.go:88 client-aborted-conn remote=10.2.5.6
```
many noise entries are client-aborted-conn which we don't want to page for.

alyssa: agree. current gen-api-5xx-rate rule is log-based and counts any ERROR containing "upstream-invoke" which is too broad. we should tighten to only page on timeouts/ooms/segfaults and ignore client-aborted-conn and 429-induced upstream failures.

maya: current alert query (pseudocode) ->
```
count_over_time({job="gen"} |~ "upstream-invoke.*ERROR"[5m]) > 20
```
Proposed change: exclude lines with client-aborted-conn and 429s, add stronger signature for io-timeout / out-of-memory / rpc-failure:
```
count_over_time({job="gen"} |~ "upstream-invoke.*(io-timeout|OOM|segfault|rpc-failure)" and !~ "client-aborted-conn|status=429"[5m]) > 10
```
also add a separate low-priority noise alert for the broad pattern (so we can see trends but not wake people).

jamal: sounds good. quick question — will excluding 429 hide real upstream capacity issues? some 429s indicate model pool is saturated.

maya: good point. proposal: keep 429s out of the critical pager but emit a P2 metric alert for 429 rate > 5% over 5m (no pager). That gives visibility without waking people.

evan: infra note: there were a couple transient packet drops on prod-east nic around the same time — I bumped the gateway pool but we should also consider increasing tcp-retry timeouts on the proxy for the next rollout. opened infra issue: https://github.com/redwood/infra/issues/4823

priya: customer impact: I checked top 10 API keys with highest 5xx — two customers (acme-analytics, quickchat) saw elevated errors (~3-7% of requests) during the 00:18–00:22 window. both are on paid plans; support notified and offered ETA.

jamal: action items I will do now:
- add regex exclusion to gen-api-5xx-rate rule and reduce the count threshold. will make change as a config PR and deploy after +1.
- create low-priority "upstream-invoke-noise" log alert (no pager) to track trend.
- create dashboard panel showing 5xx split by upstream reason.

maya: I'll prep the exact alert query and test in staging logs. copying the new query here to sanity-check before PR:
```
# critical pager (only wake SRE on severe upstream failures)
count_over_time({job="gen"} |~ "upstream-invoke.*(io-timeout|OOM|segfault|rpc-failure)" and !~ "client-aborted-conn|status=429"[5m]) > 8

# noise track (no pager)
count_over_time({job="gen"} |~ "upstream-invoke"[10m]) > 50
```

alyssa: also add a signature for "kv-cache-miss" floods — we saw repeated cache-miss patterns in earlier incidents that artificially inflate alarm counts. something like `kv-cache-miss` should be noise-excluded unless accompanied by timeout.

jamal: will include that too. planning to open PR: https://github.com/redwood/monitoring/pull/1256 with the rule changes and notes. tagging maya/evan for review.

maya: after PR merges, I'll deploy to prod and validate for 15m. will also add a grafana panel (dash link placeholder) and a saved query for the noise alert.

evan: quick review note — please add clear versioning in the monitoring repo so we can roll back if we accidentally silence a real issue.

priya: support follow-up: I'll send an update to affected customers once we confirm the mitigation succeeded and share the timeline + whether any requests were retried.

jamal: mitigation standing down: error rates trending back to baseline after gateway bump and fallback routing. keeping watch for 30m. handoff in 20m to alyssa (oncall shift).

alyssa: taking over from jamal at 00:40 UTC. jamal — please add any lingering context to the runbook and link the PR. I'll finish the monitoring deploy and schedule a short post-incident review tomorrow.

jamal: added notes to runbook and linked PR. thanks all.

incident-bot: Incident state: mitigated -> monitoring. Incident channel: #incidents/1795032100 (auto-created).

maya: follow-up todo for tomorrow:
- land PR 1256 and verify no unintended silences
- add grafana panel: "gen /generate 5xx by reason (top 10)"
- create playbook snippet: when to scale gateway vs enable fallback model

alyssa: scheduling 30-min postmortem sync tomorrow 16:00 UTC. invite: eng-sre, eng-runtime, support.

priya: I'll include a short customer-impact summary for outreach.

jamal: thanks everyone. closing active pager thread but leaving this slack thread for follow-ups.
